_readme: Curated freesound.org candidates for the v1.4 sound replacement pass.
Every 'target' maps to a file in assets/sounds/ that SoundService.init loads.
Run scripts/fetch-sounds.js with a FREESOUND_TOKEN to download them as mp3.
The fetch script re-checks each sound's license (CC0 / Attribution only -
the app monetizes, so NonCommercial is refused) and its duration against
maxDurationSec, so a wrong-length texture is caught even though the author
of this manifest cannot audition audio. Auditing by ear before shipping is
still the owner's call - reorder the combo ladder or swap in an 'alternates'
id freely. license/durationSec/verified reflect a 2026-07-15 page check;
where verified=false the script is the source of truth.
preview-hq-mp3 is already mp3 - no ffmpeg needed.

sounds.role: banner timer-freeze shimmer (also reveal-final, disarm, defeat-tail via playAt)

sounds.note: MUST be a SHORT sparkle. The obvious shimmer hits (opticaillusions 521882 = 43s, smokinghotdog 584244 = 35s) are long ambient textures - EXCLUDED. The maxDurationSec guard rejects any long clip; pick the shortest alternate that reads as magical.
